verdict.rationale: Legacy protocol support (LDAP/RADIUS endpoints) is a fair axis for an identity provider like Okta. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions LDAP, RADIUS, or VPN/Wi-Fi authentication. The cited material covers only SSO, SCIM, event hooks, the MCP server and Cross App Access, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an IT admin, legacy protocols still work — cloud LDAP and RADIUS endpoints serve the VPNs, Wi-Fi, and older systems that will never speak SAML
